_instructions: Watch annotated.mp4 and record what happened in the video, not what the pipeline said. contacts: one entry per real racket contact, with hitter 'near' or 'far'. rallies: one entry per rally actually played. Delete any contact you cannot see happen. Set labelled=true when finished. Nothing here should describe a detector.
frame_reference: outputs/<clip>/work.mp4; metadata.json holds the offset to source
_contacts_help: [{"frame": 1234, "hitter": "near"|"far"|null, "in_rally": true, "notes": ""}] -- every racket contact in the clip, whether or not anything detected it. Set in_rally=false for a contact that is not a rally shot: handing the shuttle back to the server, a knock-up between points. Those are real, but they do not belong in a rally timeline, so they are scored as neither hits nor misses.

rallies.notes: truncated by the clip start; first contact at frame 9

_rallies_help: [{"rally": 1, "start_frame": 83, "end_frame": 236, "notes": ""}] -- inclusive spans where a rally was in progress.
_labelled_contact_spans_help: Optional. [{"start_frame": 1674, "end_frame": 2467, "notes": ""}] -- the spans in which *every* racket contact has been recorded. Leave it empty when the whole clip has been gone through, which is what an empty list means. Outside these spans the contact list is known to be incomplete, so a predicted hit there is not evidence of anything and is counted in neither column. Rallies are scored over the whole clip either way: this scopes contacts, not rallies.
_tracking_failures_help: Optional. [{"start_frame": 1918, "end_frame": 3291, "kind": "...", "notes": "..."}] -- stretches where the vision stack visibly followed the wrong thing. Not scored; kept so a known failure is not rediscovered twice.
_provenance: HAND LABELS for the contacts, written by the project owner on 2026-09-15 from label-part-A.mp4 and label-part-B.mp4 -- the working video with frame numbers burned on and no pipeline output drawn on it -- and recorded as one line per contact in labels.tsv, which is kept beside this file as the primary record. Ten contacts across three rallies; the labeller reports the rest of the clip is a half-time break with no play. One correction was agreed after labelling: two entries at 1605 and 1636 were one contact and neither sat on it, so they are recorded as a single contact at 1621 keeping the labeller's hitter and shot type. The reasoning is in labels.tsv.
_rally_span_provenance: DERIVED, not watched. The labeller recorded contacts; the spans were read off the raw shuttle track afterwards by one rule -- start at the serve contact, end where the shuttle comes to rest. Weaker evidence than the contacts, and the rally-boundary figure should be read with that in front of it.
_supersedes: Model-produced labels for this clip, written by Claude on 2026-09-14 and kept at git dcf527f. They claimed 15 contacts and 4 rallies against the 10 contacts and 3 rallies found by hand.
